scope: Local browser acceptance with an isolated store, customer, two riders and simulated payment. No WeChat real-device acceptance.
checks: Platform header and order list show the unclaimed delivery timeout alert.
Rider 1 claims the order and sees the delivery address in My Deliveries.
Rider 1 reports a vehicle fault; completion is disabled and platform sees the exception.
Platform reassigns to rider 2 with a handover reason; the exception clears.
Rider 1 refreshes My Deliveries and no longer sees the order.
Rider 2 logs in, sees the reassigned order, confirms delivery and sees Completed in delivery history.
Platform order details and database confirm Completed, rider 118 and four audit events with actors and timestamps.
